snippet.title: Back to the Future DLC Pack Trailer - Rocket League
snippet.description:
Great Scott! The time continuum has been disrupted and as of October 21, 2015, the "Future" is now! The Back to the Future DLC is coming to Rocket League.

Check out the GameSpot vs. Psyionix Beatdown:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K8957i-1uJM

Follow Rocket League at GameSpot.com!
http://www.gamespot.com/rocket-league
Official Site - http://rocketleague.psyonix.com/

Check out our review!
Watch - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m9SFPAjba2M
Read - http://www.gamespot.com/reviews/rocket-league-review/1900-6416186/
